note: Grader-only ground truth for the UX review judge. Never copy this file into the fixture or any prompt the QA model sees.
app: A synthetic shop. A signed-in shopper adds a Canvas bag ($24.00) to the cart, opens Cart (shows item, Total and a Checkout button), then Checkout. Checkout shows heading Checkout, the text 'Review your details, then pay $24.00. No account needed.', labeled prefilled Email and Delivery address inputs, the note 'Billing address is the same as delivery. You can edit it before paying.' with an Edit billing address button, 'Total: $24.00', a primary 'Pay $24.00' button and a 'Cancel and return to cart' link. Paying shows 'Order confirmed' with an order number and the header changes to Cart (0). Known real, unseeded quirk: the feedback message area sits outside the page content and is not cleared on success, so after a declined payment followed by a successful retry, the old decline alert stays visible above 'Order confirmed' (a genuine issue an agent may correctly report). A declined payment shows an alert 'Payment declined. Your cart and address are saved. Try again or cancel.', keeps the entered details, and Pay can be retried. The profile page shows the saved delivery address in a labeled input with a Save address button; saving shows 'Address saved.'. A keyboard user can Tab to every action, with a visible orange focus outline. Known real, unseeded quirk: every action re-renders the whole page, so after activating a button (for example Add to cart) keyboard focus is lost and returns to the start of the document. Spacing, colors and typography are ordinary and acceptable. Unless a seeded friction below changes it, all of this behaves as described.

frictions.duplicate-address: Checkout replaces the same-as-delivery billing note with a required input labeled 'Billing address (enter the same address again)', forcing the shopper to retype an address identical to the delivery address. REVIEW.md forbids duplicate address entry.
frictions.ambiguous-next: The final checkout button reads 'Continue' instead of 'Pay $24.00', although activating it immediately completes the purchase; nothing indicates that this action pays.
frictions.lost-input: After a declined payment, the checkout form is re-rendered empty: the entered email and delivery address are lost, so the shopper must re-enter them before retrying. REVIEW.md requires preserved details.
frictions.missing-cancel: Checkout has no 'Cancel and return to cart' link; after a decline the alert says 'Try again or cancel' but no local cancel/back action exists (only the header Cart link). REVIEW.md requires cancellation back to the cart.
frictions.keyboard-barrier: The product 'Add ... to cart' buttons have tabindex=-1, so a keyboard user cannot Tab to them or add an item without a pointer. REVIEW.md requires every flow to work with a keyboard.
frictions.variant-1: A declined payment shows the alert 'Error 402: PAYMENT_DECLINED (code 51)' instead of a plain explanation; it does not say whether details were kept or what to do next (retry or cancel). REVIEW.md requires errors to explain the next action.
frictions.variant-2: Checkout no longer shows the amount anywhere before payment: the intro says 'Review your details, then pay.', the Total line is removed and the button reads 'Pay now'. REVIEW.md requires showing the total before payment.
frictions.variant-3: The checkout Email and Delivery address inputs have no visible labels, only placeholders; because they are prefilled, the placeholders are hidden and the shopper cannot tell which field is which (and the inputs lack accessible names).
frictions.variant-4: Checkout copy uses internal jargon: the intro reads 'Submit PO for tender. SKU qty locked on commit.' and the billing note reads 'BILL_ADDR := SHIP_ADDR (override via EDIT).'
frictions.variant-5: Inconsistent naming for the same concept across pages: the header link says 'Basket (n)', the cart page heading says 'Your bag', the cart's button says 'Proceed to order form' and the checkout heading says 'Order form'.
frictions.variant-6: Activating Pay first hides the form and shows an extra 'Confirm — Are you sure you want to continue?' step with a 'Yes, continue' button; it repeats no order details or total and adds a step before the real payment.
frictions.variant-7: After a declined payment, a large red primary 'Abandon order' button appears above Pay, and Pay is demoted to a small underlined text link; the destructive exit is emphasized over the retry the shopper most likely wants.
frictions.variant-8: On the profile page, after Save address succeeds ('Address saved.'), the address input is cleared to empty, so the page appears to have lost the address the shopper just saved (a reload shows it again).
frictions.variant-9: After Add to cart succeeds (status says 'Added to cart. Open Cart to review your order.'), the header link still reads 'Cart (0)'; it only updates after navigating to another page, so the persistent cart indicator contradicts the confirmation.
frictions.variant-10: The header cart link is an icon only: a decorative cart emoji hidden from assistive technology followed by the bare count (for example '🛒1'); it has no visible 'Cart' text and its accessible name is just the number.
frictions.variant-11: Opening checkout first shows a full-page 'Check out faster with an account' prompt with a primary 'Create account' button; the only way to continue as a guest is a small grey 'Not now' text button. REVIEW.md says checkout must work for guests.
frictions.variant-12: When payment is declined, no alert appears near the form and focus does not move; the decline message is rendered only as small grey text below the page footer, out of view on a phone, and is not announced. The page otherwise looks unchanged.
frictions.variant-13: All focus indicators are removed (outline: none on :focus-visible), so a keyboard user cannot see which link or button is focused while tabbing.
frictions.variant-14: The profile Delivery address input has maxlength=12, so typing '24 Example Lane' is silently cut to '24 Example L'; saving reports success and the truncated address is stored, with no warning or length hint.
frictions.variant-15: Activating 'Add Canvas bag to cart' immediately navigates to checkout instead of staying on the shop with a confirmation; the shopper cannot keep shopping or review the cart first and gets no 'Added' feedback.

clean.clean: No seeded friction. The flow behaves exactly as the app description says.
clean.intentional-brand: No seeded friction. The home-page hero uses a solid blue brand background with white text and rounded corners; REVIEW.md states it is deliberate brand styling, not a defect.
